lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd4Si8Bi4 (reduced formula NdSi2Bi) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives Bi and Nd centers 13-neighbor environments, while Si centers show 9- and 10-neighbor environments, with one Si environment described as a close-packed-like local arrangement. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and face-sharing between Bi and Nd 13-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among Si 9-vertex polyhedra; the geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional.
